headline: Secure Manitoba Provincial Park Vehicle Permits Online
reservation: A valid Manitoba Provincial Park vehicle permit is required for entry, which can be purchased online or at authorized retailers; verify current seasonal or daily rates via the official elicensing portal. While day use does not require a booking, yurt and campsite reservations at Grand Beach are highly competitive and should be checked months in advance through the Parks Reservation Service.

days.title: Ancient Dunes and White Sands

stops.name: West Beach
stops.detail: Walk the fine silica sand of this world-renowned beach, framed by dunes that rise up to twelve meters above Lake Winnipeg.

stops.name: Ancient Beach Trail
stops.detail: Hike this path to see the boulder-strewn ridges marking the historic shoreline of glacial Lake Agassiz.

days.driving: Allow 15–30 minutes for local transfers; conditions vary.
days.note: Boardwalk areas can be crowded during peak summer weekends; arrive early to secure space.

days.title: Marshlands and Mixed Wood Forests
days.start: Suggested: 8:30 AM from the Campground Hub

stops.name: Grand Beach Marsh
stops.detail: Observe migratory birds and local waterfowl from the viewing areas overlooking the nutrient-rich lagoon.

stops.name: Wild Berry Trail
stops.detail: Meander through the jack pine forest and look for seasonal Saskatoon berries along the sandy forest floor.

days.driving: Allow 20 minutes between trailheads; conditions vary.
days.note: The marsh environment is sensitive; stay on designated boardwalks and paths.

days.title: Lakeshore Vistas and Heritage

stops.name: East Beach Shoreline
stops.detail: Enjoy a quieter stretch of sand ideal for watching the rhythmic waves of the vast inland sea.

stops.name: Grand Marais Point
stops.detail: Explore the rocky outcrop where the lake meets the sky, offering a distinct geological contrast to the southern dunes.

days.driving: Allow 30 minutes for return to gateway towns; conditions vary.
days.note: Check wind conditions as Lake Winnipeg can produce significant swells unexpectedly.

intel.title: West Beach Capacity
intel.text: The primary lots at West Beach serve the largest crowds and may reach capacity during statutory holidays. Overflow options exist but require longer walks to the main boardwalk.

intel.title: Connectivity Limits
intel.text: Cellular reception is generally stable near Grand Marais but can drop significantly once deep in the jack pine hiking trails. Download offline maps before leaving the town center.

intel.title: Selkirk Supply Hub
intel.text: Full service stations are available in Selkirk and along Highway 59; Grand Marais has limited convenience options. Ensure a full tank before entering the park for extended stays.

intel.title: Midsummer Peak
intel.text: June through August offers the warmest water temperatures but also the highest visitor volume. Weekdays provide a more tranquil experience on the Ancient Beach Trail.

intel.title: Beach Entry Points
intel.text: Accessibility ramps are located at specific intervals along the West Beach boardwalk. Some sand-adjacent paths may be difficult for standard strollers or wheelchairs.

plan.arrival: Collect your rental vehicle at YWG and drive north via Highway 59; stop in Selkirk for groceries and beach supplies before reaching Grand Marais.
plan.vehicle: Standard passenger cars are suitable for paved park roads; check rental agreements for restrictions on unpaved side roads.
plan.goldenHour: Sunset over Lake Winnipeg viewed from the West Beach dunes; timing varies significantly from June to August.
